pages.contents: Single landscape page rendered and viewed: CARE logo at the upper left, title CARE Checklist of information to include when writing a case report across the top, a small BY-NC-ND license badge and a checkmark at the upper right, burgundy header row with Topic, Item, Checklist item description and Reported on Line columns. Items 1 to 13 each list a Lines and Page location in the manuscript, except items 5d, 8d, 10a, 10c, 10d, 11a and 12 which read Not Applicable and item 7 which reads Fig.4. Item 13 shows Yes with a checked box and No with an empty box. No clinical photographs, charts, measurements or patient history appear on the page.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Reporting checklist pointing to manuscript locations; it adds no patient history, measurements, diagnoses, doses or outcomes. Not Applicable entries are reporting-form answers, not patient negatives; the checked Yes consent box is administrative documentation.

rights_exceptions.interpretation: The printed template badge reads BY-NC-ND while article metadata states CC BY-NC 4.0; both are preserved and the scope of the badge is not adjudicated.

limitations: Administrative checklist; no clinical-schema facts extracted.
AI document inspection, not physician adjudication or measured accuracy.
